title: PK DOCUMENT TRACKING SYSTEM / SYSTEM FLOWCHART

pages.title: 1. Sign in and set your password
pages.start: User opens the system
pages.action: Enter username and password; change the temporary password when prompted
pages.question: Account and password accepted?
pages.yes: Open Overview and the pages available to the user's roles
pages.no: Read the error; correct the details or contact an administrator, then retry
pages.result: User can work within the account's permissions
notes: New and reset accounts must change their temporary password before using protected pages.
Choose a different password of at least 9 characters; enter the same new password twice.
Primary and assigned active roles combine permissions. Sign out after work on a shared device.

pages.title: 2. Find a document and open its current file
pages.start: User needs a document or its approved file
pages.action: Open the register; search or filter; choose Table or Folder; open the document
pages.question: Document and file action available to this user?
pages.yes: Review document details; use Download or Print when offered, or Softcopy File History
pages.no: Request access for a Softcopy or Hardcopy when offered, or contact document control
pages.result: User receives the authorized information or current approved file
notes: Page access, document access and file actions are separate permissions. Pending proposal files are for authorized review.
External Documents use a separate category list and a Download action for the current file.
Softcopy shows permitted revision history. External revision records remain stored but have no separate File History action.

pages.title: 3. Register, edit and track a Hardcopy
pages.start: Document controller opens Hardcopy Documents
pages.action: Add or edit the physical record, storage place and any retention dates; confirm Save
pages.question: Permission, record details and storage valid?
pages.yes: Save the Hardcopy record and show its holder, location, status and retention countdown
pages.no: Correct the stated problem and retry; the unsuccessful change is not applied
pages.result: The register identifies the physical document and where it is held
notes: Only an Administrator or the current holder with direct permission can edit. Only an Administrator can select a different holder.
New Hardcopy creation and update requests are unavailable; authorized users maintain records directly.
Choose matching Area, Specific, optional Asset and Location. Tracking retention requires both dates in order.

pages.title: 4. Add or revise a Softcopy or External Document directly
pages.start: Authorized document controller opens the electronic register
pages.action: Choose Add or Edit; enter details and the register's category; upload the file; confirm Save
pages.question: Direct permission and document file valid?
pages.yes: Register the document or publish its replacement revision immediately
pages.no: Correct the details or upload problem and retry; keep the existing approved record
pages.result: The current approved file is available; permitted Softcopy history shows earlier revisions
notes: Softcopy Categories and External Categories are separate. Files must pass upload checks and be no larger than 15 MB.
A new registration and a revision both require a document file. Revision numbers and levels advance automatically.
Direct actions apply immediately. External revision records remain stored; a File History action is not provided.

pages.title: 5. Prepare a Softcopy or External Document request
pages.start: Requester needs a new electronic document or a revision
pages.action: Choose the Softcopy or External request tab; select create or revise; enter details and upload the file
pages.question: Request details, file and selected document valid?
pages.yes: Save the draft; review the proposal and submit through My Requests
pages.no: Correct the reported problem and save again before submitting
pages.result: The proposed document waits for approval; its file is not yet the current approved file
notes: Default route: Requester's leader, then Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer. Published routes can be changed.
Revision requests select an active document in the correct register. The existing approved file remains current during review.
New Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable. Retained historical requests may still appear.

pages.title: 6. Save and submit a request
pages.start: Requester opens an own draft or returned request
pages.action: Check the proposal, selected document, attachments and remarks; save changes; choose Submit
pages.question: Request valid and published approvers available?
pages.yes: Submit the request and send the first approval task to the assigned user or role
pages.no: Read the error; fix the proposal or ask an administrator to fix the route, then retry
pages.result: My Requests shows Submitted and its approval progress
notes: A returned request keeps its original approval route when resubmitted, even after an administrator publishes a newer route.
Cancel is available only for an own draft. Delete is limited to an own cancelled draft that was never submitted.
New Hardcopy create/update and Softcopy cancellation requests are unavailable; their past records remain readable.

pages.title: 7. Approve an assigned request
pages.start: Assigned approver opens a request in My Tasks
pages.action: Review the proposal, permitted files, approval history and remarks; choose Approve and confirm
pages.question: This is the final approval step?
pages.yes: Apply the approved document change, access, assignment, disposal or transfer preparation
pages.no: Activate the next approval step; the next assigned approver reviews the request
pages.result: Record the decision and show updated progress; continue until final approval
notes: Only the currently assigned user or an active member of the assigned role can decide that step.
The approved operation takes effect at final approval. An approved transfer still requires Dispatch and Accept.
If a decision cannot be saved or applied, read the error and refresh before retrying.

pages.title: 8. Return or reject a request
pages.start: Assigned approver finds a problem during review
pages.action: Review the issue, enter clear remarks and choose Return or Reject
pages.question: Return for another review?
pages.yes: Reopen the immediately previous approval step; a return from the first step goes to the requester
pages.no: Reject and close the request; retain the decision history without applying the proposed change
pages.result: Review resumes at the proper point; the requester edits and resubmits only after a first-step return
notes: A return from a later step leaves the request Submitted and gives the task back to the previous approver.
After that approver approves again, the returned step must review again before approval can advance.
A first-step return marks the request Returned. The requester corrects it and resubmits using the original route.

pages.title: 9. Request approval to transfer a Hardcopy
pages.start: Requester needs to transfer an active Hardcopy
pages.action: Select the document, receiving user, destination storage and remarks; save and submit the transfer request
pages.question: Request receives every required approval?
pages.yes: Prepare the approved handoff and show the transfer as For Transfer
pages.no: Follow Return or Reject instructions; dispatch is unavailable until final approval
pages.result: Requester can dispatch the approved physical document
notes: Default route: Plant Manager, then Document Control Officer, then Requester confirmation.
The source and destination must be valid and the receiving account active; conflicting pending requests or transfers can block it.
Approval alone does not change the current holder or complete physical receipt.

pages.title: 10. Dispatch and accept the physical document
pages.start: Approved Hardcopy transfer is For Transfer
pages.action: Requester confirms Dispatch; receiving user opens the handoff task after the document arrives
pages.question: Receiving user confirms Accept?
pages.yes: Complete the transfer and update the Hardcopy holder and destination location
pages.no: Keep the transfer In Transit; the receiving user accepts only after confirming receipt
pages.result: The register records accepted custody and the handoff history
notes: Only the requester dispatches. Only the named receiving user accepts that transfer.
Dispatch marks In Transit. Custody and location change after acceptance.
Direct reassignment is a separate immediate action and is blocked while a transfer is active.

pages.title: 11. Request personal access or document assignment
pages.start: Requester chooses Document Access or Document Assignment
pages.action: Select an active Softcopy or Hardcopy; enter the reason and, for access, a future expiry; save and submit
pages.question: Request receives every required approval?
pages.yes: Grant access until expiry, or assign the Softcopy to the requester or make the requester the Hardcopy holder
pages.no: Follow the return or rejection outcome; no new access or assignment takes effect
pages.result: The requester receives the approved personal access or assignment
notes: Access default: Plant Manager, Document Control Officer, Requester confirmation. Assignment ends with Requester's leader instead.
These requests are for the requester; they do not select another recipient. External Documents are not supported here.
Access expires at the end of the chosen day. Assignment is separate from an access grant; file permissions still apply.

pages.title: 12. Dispose a document directly
pages.start: Authorized controller selects an active document in its register
pages.action: Choose Dispose; select Shred, Scratch or Other; describe Other when used; confirm disposal
pages.question: Required direct permissions and reason valid?
pages.yes: Mark the document Disposed and record the reason, actor, date and previous state
pages.no: Read the error and correct the reason or permissions before retrying
pages.result: Disposed status and disposal history appear in the register
notes: Direct disposal supports Hardcopy, Softcopy and External Documents; both register direct and disposal direct permission are required.
Softcopy disposal retires its files. External disposal keeps stored files and revision records but blocks normal download.
Direct Hardcopy disposal keeps its recorded location. Approval-based Hardcopy disposal clears the location and personal grants.

pages.title: 13. Request Hardcopy or External Document disposal
pages.start: Requester needs approval to dispose an active document
pages.action: Choose Disposal Request; select Hardcopy or External, the document and disposal reason; save and submit
pages.question: Every required approver approves disposal?
pages.yes: Dispose the selected document and preserve its approval and disposal history
pages.no: Follow Return or Reject instructions; the proposed disposal is not applied
pages.result: The completed request identifies the disposed document and approved reason
notes: Local route checked 5 Nov 2026: Plant Manager, Document Control Officer, Requester confirms. Softcopy disposal requests are unavailable.
Choose Shred, Scratch or Other. Other requires a description of up to 250 characters.
Approved Hardcopy disposal clears Location and personal grants. External disposal records status and history; stored files remain.

pages.title: 14. Assign documents directly
pages.start: Authorized controller opens Document Assignments
pages.action: Choose a document, Hardcopy location or Softcopy category branch; select the receiving user and confirm
pages.question: Active documents and user eligible for assignment?
pages.yes: Assign Softcopies to the user, or immediately change the Hardcopy current holder
pages.no: Resolve active transfers, choose valid records or reduce the selection, then retry
pages.result: The assignment list and document details show the new assignment or holder
notes: Softcopy category assignment includes its subcategories. Location assignment includes all active Hardcopies stored there.
Bulk assignment supports up to 2,000 active documents. An active Hardcopy transfer blocks reassignment.
Direct assignment needs no approval or Dispatch/Accept. It does not create a separate personal access grant.

pages.title: 15. Maintain places and category folders
pages.start: Authorized maintainer opens Setup Places
pages.action: Choose the place or category tab; add or edit its name, folder and parent details; confirm Save
pages.question: Details, parent relationships and permission valid?
pages.yes: Save the reference entry and make it available to the appropriate document register
pages.no: Correct the reported name, parent or relationship problem and retry
pages.result: Document entry and Folder browsing use the maintained references
notes: Areas, Specifics, optional Assets and Locations describe Hardcopy storage. Maintain their valid parent relationships.
Softcopy Categories and External Categories are separate trees. Categories can contain subcategories.
Deactivate an entry to stop new selection while retaining historical links; existing relationships can restrict changes.

pages.title: 16. Create, update or deactivate a user account
pages.start: Authorized account administrator opens User Management
pages.action: Enter user details, Primary role, Assigned roles and leader; save, reset the password or choose Deactivate
pages.question: Roles, reporting line and account changes allowed?
pages.yes: Save the account; securely provide any generated temporary password to the intended user
pages.no: Correct the invalid role, reporting line or protected account change and retry
pages.result: The account has the selected access and leader; new or reset users change password at next sign-in
notes: Primary and assigned active roles combine permissions. The leader receives steps configured as Requester's leader.
Users cannot deactivate themselves or change their own roles. The final active Administrator cannot be removed.
Account and role changes can require a fresh sign-in. Assigned Documents requires both user-view and direct-assignment permission.

pages.title: 17. Maintain roles and permissions
pages.start: Authorized role administrator opens Roles & Permissions
pages.action: Add or edit a role name and allowed actions; save, deactivate or remove the selected role
pages.question: Role change permitted and required references clear?
pages.yes: Save the permitted actions or deactivate/remove the unused role
pages.no: Reassign affected users or workflow steps, finish dependent requests, or correct permissions; retry
pages.result: Assigned active roles determine which pages and actions users can use
notes: Supplied roles: Administrator, Document Control Officer, Plant Manager, Internal Auditor and Staff. Custom roles can be added.
Administrator privileges are fixed. Other roles can be configured; an administrator cannot delegate actions they lack.
A role cannot be deactivated or removed while assigned to users, used by current workflows or needed by unfinished requests.

pages.title: 18. Publish an approval route
pages.start: Authorized workflow administrator opens Workflow Builder
pages.action: Create Next Draft; add or edit approvers; move or remove steps; choose Validate & Publish
pages.question: Route has 1-30 valid ordered approval steps?
pages.yes: Publish the draft as the default for future submissions of that request type
pages.no: Correct missing steps or unavailable users and roles, then validate again
pages.result: Future requests follow the new route; submitted requests retain their original route
notes: Approvers can be a specific user, any active member of a role, the Requester's leader or the Requester account.
Published versions are read-only. Use Create Next Draft, or Start First Draft when no version exists.
Only one draft per workflow is available. The request types are predefined; configuring a route does not enable retired request types.

pages.title: 19. Respond to task and retention notices
pages.start: User sees a task notice, unread bell entry or retention reminder
pages.action: Open the notice; inspect the linked request, handoff or Hardcopy record
pages.question: Further action required and permitted?
pages.yes: Complete the assigned task, or arrange the appropriate Hardcopy review or disposal process
pages.no: Close the notice; acknowledging or dismissing it does not approve, transfer or dispose a document
pages.result: The user reaches the relevant work and follows its separate action process
notes: Selecting an unread bell entry acknowledges that entry. Opening the panel does not mark every entry read.
Retention reminders concern visible active Hardcopies with retention enabled and an end date today or earlier, using Manila dates.
Retention reminders are shown once per document and end date in the browser session; dismissing one leaves the record unchanged.

pages.title: 20. Review the Internal Audit Trail
pages.start: Administrator, Document Control Officer or Internal Auditor needs to trace a recorded action
pages.action: Open Internal Audit Trail; search and filter by date or outcome; review the actor, action and details
pages.question: Required action found in the audit records?
pages.yes: Read its timestamp, user, outcome and recorded details; compare with the document or request history
pages.no: Adjust the search or dates; ask the system administrator to investigate missing or unavailable records
pages.result: The reviewer can trace the recorded action and identify any follow-up work
notes: The supplied Administrator, Document Control Officer and Internal Auditor roles can view the audit trail; custom grants may differ.
Use success or failed outcomes to narrow the list. Audit review does not change a document or reverse an approval.
Document details and request approval history provide related context for the recorded action.

pages.title: 21. Create and manage backup archives
pages.start: Authorized backup operator opens Backup & Restore
pages.action: Choose Backup now, Import backup, Download or Clean up; confirm the selected operation
pages.question: Backup setup and selected archive valid?
pages.yes: Create or import a verified encrypted archive, download it, or remove expired archives
pages.no: Read the setup or archive error; correct it before repeating the operation
pages.result: The archive list and operation message show the backup outcome
notes: Viewing backups and managing or downloading them require different permissions. Check the success message and resulting archive.
The displayed daily target is 5:00 PM Asia/Manila. Automatic backup runs require separate administrator setup and verification.
Clean up removes expired backup and log archives under the configured retention rules. Import verifies the supplied backup ZIP.

pages.title: 22. Restore system records and private files
pages.start: Authorized backup operator chooses Restore system data
pages.action: Select Backup to restore; enter Your password; type RESTORE; confirm Restore selected backup
pages.question: Password, confirmation and backup checks pass?
pages.yes: Create a recovery backup; restore the selected records and private files; sign out the operator
pages.no: Read the failure message; correct the credentials, confirmation or archive before retrying
pages.result: Sign in again and verify the restored records, users and files
notes: Restore replaces live records and private files. Normal use is temporarily blocked during the maintenance operation.
A recovery backup is created before replacement. Keep the selected backup and recovery archive available for follow-up checks.
Application code recovery is an offline maintenance task; it is not performed by the Restore system data button.
